page.overview:
Who is Enwright?

Commodore Enwright was a 23rd century Starfleet flag officer who served as the commander of Starbase 6 during the late 2260s.

In 2268, Commodore Enwright ordered the to his station. He contacted the Enterprise before they could initiate contact. When asked by Captain James T. Kirk what the reason for the diversion was, Enwright told him that the explanation was beaming aboard the Enterprise as they spoke and might have already materialized.

The explanation in question, Bob Wesley, explained that the Enterprise had been chosen to test the tactical abilities of Dr. Richard Daystrom's experimental M-5 multitronic unit against an attack force commanded by Wesley. ()

According to the first draft of the script, dated , Enwright beamed aboard the Enterprise along with Wesley to brief Spock and Kirk in the transporter room.
